title: What's this?

objectives.label: Say what something is
objectives.descriptorEN: Use the frame 'To je ___.' with a word you already have.

objectives.label: Ask what something is
objectives.descriptorEN: Use 'Kaj je to?' for a thing he won't name — then again later, unprompted.

objectives.label: Put him right
objectives.descriptorEN: When he calls the umbrella a book, correct him: 'Ne.' followed by 'To je ___.'

frameEN: Slavko's turned up with a bag over his shoulder.
He's going to take things out of it, one at a time.
Today you learn how to say what something is — and how to ask.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Živjo! Glej, danes sem prinesel torbo. Notri je nekaj stvari.
n1.en: Hi! Look, today I brought a bag. There are a few things in it.
n1.deliverySL: [warmly, conspiratorial] Živjo! Glej, danes sem prinesel torbo. Notri je nekaj stvari.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Poglej, to besedo že znaš. To je dežnik. Povej še ti.
n2.en: Look, you already know this word. This is an umbrella. Now you say it.
n2.deliverySL: [proudly] Poglej, to besedo že znaš. [deliberately] To je dežnik. [warmly] Povej še ti.
n2.slowSL: Poglej … to besedo že znaš … To je dežnik … Povej še ti.
n2.deliverySlowSL: [warmly, slowly] Poglej … [very slowly] to besedo že znaš … [deliberately, drawn out] To je dežnik … [warmly, slowly] Povej še ti.

c1.speaker: client
c1.en: Say it back to him: 'To je' plus the word you got out of him last time — dežnik.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Dežnik gre nazaj v torbo. Zdaj pa tole: to je ključ. Ključ. Daj, ti.
n3.en: The umbrella goes back in the bag. And now this: this is a key. Key. Go on, your turn.
n3.deliverySL: [playfully] Dežnik gre nazaj v torbo. Zdaj pa tole: to je ključ. Ključ. Daj, ti.
n3.slowSL: Dežnik gre nazaj v torbo … Zdaj pa tole … to je ključ … Ključ … Daj, ti.
n3.deliverySlowSL: [very slowly] Dežnik gre nazaj v torbo … [very slowly] Zdaj pa tole … [deliberately, drawn out] to je ključ … [very slowly, drawn out] Ključ … [warmly, slowly] Daj, ti.

c2.speaker: client
c2.en: Name it: 'To je' plus the new word he just gave you — ključ.

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Odlično! Zdaj pa imam nekaj v roki. Vprašaj me: Kaj je to?
n4.en: Excellent! Now I've got something in my hand. Ask me: What is this?
n4.deliverySL: [delighted, then teasing] Odlično! Zdaj pa imam nekaj v roki. Vprašaj me: Kaj je to?
n4.slowSL: Odlično … Zdaj pa imam nekaj v roki … Vprašaj me … Kaj je to?
n4.deliverySlowSL: [delighted] Odlično … [very slowly] Zdaj pa imam nekaj v roki … [very slowly] Vprašaj me … [deliberately, drawn out] Kaj je to?

c3.speaker: client
c3.en: Ask him what it is — the question he just gave you.

n5.speaker: npc
n5.deliverySlowSL: [deliberately, drawn out] To je knjiga … [very slowly, drawn out] Knjiga.

c4.speaker: client
c4.en: Say what it is: 'To je' plus his new word — knjiga.

n6.speaker: npc
n6.en: I've got one more thing in the bag.
n6.deliverySL: [mischievous, then waiting] V torbi imam še nekaj.

c5.speaker: client
c5.en: Ask him yourself this time — he is not going to prompt you.

n7.speaker: npc
n7.sl: O, spet dežnik! V roki imam dežnik. To je knjiga.
n7.en: Oh, the umbrella again! I've got an umbrella in my hand. This is a book.
n7.deliverySL: [flat, deadpan, entirely serious] O, spet dežnik! V roki imam dežnik. To je knjiga.

n8.speaker: npc
n8.sl: Hm. Je to res knjiga? Povej mi.
n8.en: Hmm. Is this really a book? Tell me.
n8.deliverySL: [innocently, still deadpan] Hm. Je to res knjiga? [inviting] Povej mi.

stallHandlers.label: Tell him what it really is

c6.speaker: client
c6.en: Put him right: say 'ne', then name it properly.

n9.speaker: npc
n9.sl: Ha, ja, seveda! To je dežnik. Malo sem se šalil.
n9.en: Ha, yes, of course! This is an umbrella. I was joking a bit.
n9.deliverySL: [cracking up, sheepish] Ha, ja, seveda! To je dežnik. Malo sem se šalil.

n10.speaker: npc
n10.sl: Na, to je tvoja knjiga. Adijo!
n10.en: Here, this is your book. Bye!
n10.deliverySL: [warmly, on his way out] Na, to je tvoja knjiga. Adijo!

c7.speaker: client
c7.en: Thank him and say bye — two words you already own.
